notes.title: Dwarven Skykeep - tower building strategy with deep gameplay, Dwarves & Beer
notes.content:
What could be better than high-quality pixel art and a non-trivial indie game?

￼🧙‍♂️ Dwarven Skykeep - is a deep base-building strategy with non-linear post-modern storyline, Dwarves and beer.

It's very simple: build a magic Tower and defend it from enemies at night.

Enemies burn books in Libraries, and rain drowns basements. Friendly Dwarves are ready to help.
You cast spells - they repair.
🍻 You provide beer and they fight the Goblins.

Finally, catch the Sun Spark with the Mirror. Until the Goblins broke it.

🧙‍♂️Dwarven Skykeep -
- multiple replayable levels
- deck building
- metroidvania style
- original soundtrack
- cool pixel art
- deep plot with humor

👉 Follow the game news and add Dwarven Skykeep to your Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076120/Dwarven_Skykeep/

notes.title: A Big Update!
notes.content:
A big update comes to those who wait for it!

*Please note that some of those improvement will only work when you start a new game!


Korean, German, Polish, Brazilian translations
all-new spellbook layout
improved game performance during enemy turn
fixed growth rate of treasuries
War Academy now accessible earlier in the game
even more variety in neutral creature types
lots, lots of crashes fixed
creatures grow slower on Easy difficulty
fixed some achievements
Alt+Enter support for Windows
Alt+F4 fixed for Windows
You can now send us your saves and logs to report a problem (button is available in game settings) 
new fog of war
animated morale and luck in combat
combat field of view now dragable and zoomable with ctrl-/+
creature info now accessible by clicking on combat sequence
improved quick combat
under the hood loading speed optimization

notes.title: You Said - We Listened
notes.content:
You should be already downloading this update, as I'm typing it. We fixed some nasty bugs, and added some cool new stuff:

- You requested more difficulty options. You've got now Easy mode (more creatures to hire, and more gold on the map), and Hard Mode (unlockable after you complete the game on Easy or Normal)

- The Wait Turn button for combat. This one was requested by more experienced players, and is available on Hard Difficulty. We personally believe it doesn't add much gameplay, but we might be wrong. Besides, hey - you asked for it. 

- Fixed some real annoying crashes

- Fixed problems with Puzzle Map

- Polish Translation

- Right click spells description in combat

- Fixed Observation tower (being unable to enter it again)

- Right click on map creatures shows quantity now

We hope you will enjoy playing this update.
P.S. if you want to play on Easy Difficulty, you will haveto start a new game. Your current save files are "Normal Difficulty".
